summary: The immediate crisis is an Outlook account lockout that must be resolved today, but the bigger push is launching the Intelligent China webpage this week and advancing the knowledge website redesign and global marketing strategy for Asia Star and Intelligent China.
summaryDetail: Right now, the most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout: the team needs to delete and re-add the account on all devices, re-login on phones, and confirm with JSB that the backend lock is released. On the strategic front, the top priority is launching the Intelligent China webpage this week to start driving traffic, as part of the broader global marketing push that prioritizes Asia Star and Intelligent China over US partnerships (Stanford, Berkeley, Columbia), which are on hold except for Berkeley as a third option. The knowledge website redesign is also moving forward: decisions are made on the two-menu structure, article page design, and homepage layout, and Joseph needs to share the HTML file and meet with Julie for specific feedback. This week, Joseph must also draft target areas and provide the conversion tracking brief, while the team audits the conversion tracking setup and analyzes participant profiles. Looking ahead, several items are due in mid-October, including Ira's review of the EuroCham Shanghai concept note, the Women in Leadership Forum invitation, CKGSB Americas website reply, Asia Start follow-ups, and Sino-Swiss Economic Forum engagements, plus the SproutVideo renewal and Macrobond discussion.

decisions.text: Remove the videos panel from the knowledge website and disperse videos by topic instead.
Keep the two-menu structure with 'Knowledge' and 'School' menus.
Use the article page design that includes prominent authors, audio, pullout quotes, and varied title font sizes.
Display more articles on the homepage, including a pinned article and a section for latest articles.
Bring the BCI index banner into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not include a stock market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for marketing efforts.
Put US partnerships (Stanford, Berkeley, Columbia) on hold initially, but consider Berkeley as a third priority.
Launch Intelligent China webpage this week to start driving traffic.
Renew SproutVideo annual subscription for another year
